title: /webapi/oauth2/token
summary: Reference for /webapi/oauth2/token endpoint used to obtain Bearer tokens for Alteryx Server API.
body_markdown:
> **ℹ️ Info**
>
> **/webapi/oauth2/token** endpoint is used to get the Bearer Token and is not logged to the Gallery logs as other API endpoints are [tested 23.1]

# How to test in Postman

Adjust for your Server URL, client_id and client_secret

The following can be imported into Postman and edited, but the above is easy to setup from scratch.
